title: "M8 - Standalone Module"

## Purpose

This page summarizes the standalone technical scope of M8 - Time Series Forecasting.

## Technical Scope

- Frontend: Angular served via Node.js
- Backend: FastAPI on Python 3.12
- Structured CSV input with temporal and numeric columns
- Optional Docker deployment and reverse proxy/HTTPS integration
- Designed for analytics workflows and not certified for mission-critical usage

## Run Guidance

Use backend /datasets, /algorithms, /predict endpoints and frontend UI according to module repositories

## Expected Outcome

A reproducible execution path suitable for technical validation, demonstrations, and staged integration into platform workflows.
